rules.accepted_credit_types: Approved providers under 49 Pa. Code §33.403; live interactive webinars count as lecture
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from the 20 hours for the biennial period of initial licensure (e.g. licensed 4/1/23-3/31/25); child abuse training still required.
rules.alternatives: Written waiver request for illness, emergency or hardship, decided case by case.
rules.audit_note: Child abuse course completion must be reported electronically by the approved provider.

topics.who: Act 31 mandated child abuse recognition and reporting, from an approved provider

rules.notes: At least 50% lecture/clinical; max 50% online/individual study. Current infant, child and adult CPR required; hands-on CPR courses do not count as CE. Local anesthesia permit: 3 h on local anesthesia incl. pharmacology. PHDHP: 5 h public health.
